title: "Quick Event Creation" missing from context menu

posts.author: draziwthewizard
posts.body:
As the title says, while following the tutorial I get stuck here. I've tried multiple times to go from the beginning and mess around but the voice is just missing from the context menu. This is RPG Maker MZ Free Trial.
I have done some research online but nothing adresses this problem.
Solution? Cause?
Thank you
edit: turns out is a graphical glitch that does not soley affect context menus. I have tried a couple of things to hope it would work but nah. Help?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
what is your editor version?
does your computer have one or two graphics chips, and which ones?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
I haven't seen this specifically before, but I've seen some other stuff with glitching menus in MZ.
The most common causes are making sure your graphics driver is up to date from the manufacturer, and checking whether you have Windows set to scaling your display.

posts.author: draziwthewizard
posts.body:
It's 1.8.1.
I have a laptop with an AMD integrated and a dedicated Nvidia Geforce RTX 3050Ti.
RPG Maker MV does work though, I've completed the tutorial on it.
